시편 96:1.content: O sing unto the Lord a new song: sing unto the Lord, all the earth.

시편 96:2.content: Sing unto the Lord, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

시편 96:3.content: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

시편 96:4.content: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

시편 96:5.content: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.

시편 96:6.content: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

시편 96:7.content: Give unto the Lord, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

시편 96:8.content: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

시편 96:9.content: O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

시편 96:10.content: Say among the heathen that the Lord reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

시편 96:11.content: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

시편 96:12.content: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

시편 96:13.content: Before the Lord: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
